game_concept: A adventure race set in Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation, a waystation for merchants: the scarab scholar must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so giant scorpions can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation: a waystation for merchants
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Waystation, repeat each round: Write input checks that reject bad data so giant scorpions can't sneak through. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the scarab scholar ahead. Then check the fortress value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the sundial by solving code steps involving fortress that move the scarab scholar forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the sundial first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Validation Fortress
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Merchant Waystation'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fortress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Merchant Waystation.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
